phase_source_policy.freeze_period: Claude execution childbranch: before first extraction checkout through chain completion; GPTdevelopment isolated and not merged during the chain
phase_source_policy.invalidation: any covered source change invalidates all twelve extraction receipts under the amended code, including resource-only changes
phase_source_policy.action: stop chain; preserve all artifacts; no receipt rewrite, accepted-source whitelist or automatic resubmission
phase_source_policy.repeat_requires: new Claude review, new IDs/outputs, complete new estimate and Simone decision; all twelve extractions repeated
phase_source_policy.additional_cpu: checkout, benchmark and later CPU work must be re-estimated

first_extraction_quota_rule: Claude refreshes both filesystem/quota checks immediately before first extraction submission; no automatic lowering oflimits or retentionextension

classification_numeric_compatibility.name: historical-libraries-plus-openmp8-v1
classification_numeric_compatibility.historical_pools: multiset inclusion with exact equality of all six fields
classification_numeric_compatibility.new_benchmarks_and_fits: one exact numeric_sha256 across all new cells
classification_numeric_compatibility.interpretation: same historical numerical libraries, versions and threads; new process also imports torch; extra OpenMP runtimes do not establish identical fitted predictions

storage_policy.regeneration_requires: pinned WORKcheckpoints plus original data, calibration, frozen code/config and environment; regeneration is a new compute operation, not an automatic retry or promise of future availability
storage_policy.phase_export: Claude copies receipts, reports, manifests, audits and SLURMaccounting toMac and commits non-payload metadata at end of eachphase before releasingnext; codeSHAandreviewpins preserved

storage_policy.work_check: fresh project quota plusinodes; >=8GiBheadroom +1GiBnewcode/log allowance +already-admitted unfinishedWORKoutputs includingFT15; no doublecountbytesalreadywritten
